verdict: Organic visibility dropped sharply this week; paid channels remain off.
narrative: All activity this period came through your Google Business Profile and organic web traffic — paid ads on Meta and Google have been inactive for the full 28 days, so there is no paid pipeline to report. Your Business Profile drove 36 actions over the period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), but that activity collapsed to zero over the last 7 days, and website sessions in the most recent 3 days fell 65% compared to the 3 days prior. The profile's drop began around August 25th and has held at zero for 12 consecutive days, which points to a structural visibility issue rather than normal week-to-week fluctuation. We are investigating what triggered the falloff in profile engagement and taking steps to restore it, and the paid channels situation is also being addressed so organic is no longer carrying the full load.
